description: Demolition of existing garages and erection of three wheelchair accessible bungalows, two two-bedroom two-storey houses and one two-storey three-bedroom house with three car parking spaces, associated cycle and waste storage, landscaping and boundary treatment
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([3667F - LB - XX - ZZ - DR - L - 240000 - P1], [3667F - LB - XX - ZZ - DR - L - 200000 - P4], [3667F - LB - XX - ZZ - DR - L - 210000 - P4], Received: 14/04/2022, [3667F - LB - XX - ZZ - DR - A - 130000-P6], [3667F - LB - XX - ZZ - DR - A - 130001-P1], [WIE-SA-95-0038-A02], received 1 March 2022, [3667F - LB - XX - 00 - DR - A - 120000-P3], [Addendum Report], received 13 January 2022; [3667F-LBXX-02-DR-A-120001-P2] and [3667F-LB-XX-02-DR-A-110000-P2], [3667F-LB-XX-DR-A-101000-P2], [Cover Letter], [Design and Access Statement], [Planning Statement], [Daylight and Sunlight Report], [Fire Safety Statement], [Transport Statement], [Preliminary Groundwater Screening Assessment], received 21 September 2021, and [Sustainability Report Rev. B PA1584] dated August 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - 
The rear gardens of the three two-storey houses hereby approved shall be enclosed by 1.8 metre high close boarded timber fences or the existing boundary treatment shall be retained, if higher and in a sound and safe state.  Timber fences not exceeding one metre high shall enclose the front gardens.

Condition : 5 - A.	No solar panels shall be installed on site until details of their position and appearance have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The details so approved shall be implemented before the dwellings are occupied.
B.	Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Sustainability Report and any subsequent approved revisions.
C.	Upon final commencement of operation of any low and zero carbon technologies, performance data for energy consumption must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The performance data shall be submitted every 18 months to a monitoring web-platform for a period of three years from the point of full operation.
D.	If the development as implemented fails to result in a net zero-carbon development, as indicated by the first set of data recovered under clause 'C' above,  the applicant shall, within six months of first occupation have entered into a binding arrangement with the Council that will secure a suitable contribution to the Council's Carbon Offset Fund to compensate fully for this shortfall at the rate applicable at the time of first occupation

Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 Litres per person per day or less.

Condition : 7 - The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
"	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
"	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
"	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 8 - The hard and soft landscaping details shown in the approved drawings shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and maintained in accordance with such thereafter. Any trees or plants that, within 5 years of planting, die, are cut down, uprooted, destroyed or become (in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority) seriously damaged or defective, shall be replaced with another tree or plant of the same size and species within the first planting season following its death, removal, uprooting or destruction, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its prior written approval to any variation.  Play equipment shall be installed in the communal open space area before the development is first occupied in accordance with details that shall first have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  This shall be retained permanently or replace with comparable equipment if it becomes damaged or unsafe.

Condition : 9 - Before commencement of works, the developer shall carry out a survey of the condition of the highway and footway within 20 metres of the site to establish any pre-existing damage of the pavement and carriageway and shall submit the same to the Council's highways contractor.
During works, an appropriate wheel-washing system shall be operated to remove mud, stones and other extraneous materials from vehicle wheels and chassis' leaving the site, and all departing loads shall be fully covered to ensure no material is deposited on the highway. The exit from the wheel wash shall be a hard, non-porous surface sited as far away from the exit as is possible given the site constraints and kept clean at all times.  Waste water discharged from the wheel wash shall be stored and disposed of on site and not discharged into the public sewer unless soil, stones and any suspended material have first been removed.
The developer shall ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to adjoining properties in accordance with the guidance at https://www.london.gov.uk/file/18750/download?token=zV3ZKTpP. 
Site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers or direct light into any neighbouring windows in accordance with the guidance provided by the Institute of Lighting Engineers Guidance Note: For The Reduction Of Obtrusive Light 2021.
All vehicle arrivals and departures shall be supervised and the condition of the highway examined immediately afterwards.  Any materials shed from the vehicle during such movement shall be immediately removed from the highway, and returned to site or carted away for disposal and shall not be washed into the surface water drainage system.
From the outset of works on site, details shall be prominently displayed at the boundaries of the site, indicating who members of the public can contact and including a phone number available 24 hours a day to obtain resolution of any site-related problems t

Condition : 10 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8 am to 6 pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 am to 1 pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Prior to any demolition and construction work, neighbours shall be given details outlining construction timeframes (including when demolition and piling will take place).

Condition : 11 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until cycle storage has been made available for use in strict accordance with details that shall first have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and this shall thereafter be retained as such, without obstruction, for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 12 - Prior to the first occupation of the hereby approved development waste and recycling storage  shall be made available for each dwelling, either in the form of  a proprietary timber refuse store to contain all storage bins required for the purposes of the Council's kerbside refuse and recycling collection system, not exceeding 1.3 metre high, 1.5 metres wide and one metre deep with self-closing doors, or in the form of a communal refuse store details of the appearance and location of which shall have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, or as a combination of both types of storage arrangements.

Condition : 13 - All the hard surfaced ground areas within the development shall be porous, so as to reduce the direct discharge of rainwater into the public sewerage system and no part of the development hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that all works have been carried out in this manner.

Condition : 14 - No of the trees on the grassed area between the existing garages and the entrance to the site tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor topped or lopped without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work) or any other BS replacing this.  Appropriate measaure shall be taken in accordance with industry best practice to protect the retained trees for the duration of the works on site.
(b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time or in such other location as may be specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 15 - No works shall commence above ground until the developer has entered into a binding agreement to secure the implementation prior to first occupation of measures to ensure that the access road to the site as shown on the approved drawings shall not be parked on once the development is occupied.  This provision shall remain in place permanently.  The site layout shall have been designed and implemented to provide for full access by a Council refuse truck.  Details of both these measures shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 16 - Prior to occupation, the development shall achieve 'Secured by Design' accreditation awarded by the Design-Out Crime Officer from the Metropolitan Police Service on behalf of the Association of Chief Police Officers (ACPO).
No dwelling shall be occupied until accreditation has been achieved and evidence of such accreditation has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 17 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the hereby approved development or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 18 - All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development hereby approved shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the GLA's supplementary planning guidance (SPG) 'Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition' dated July 2014, or subsequent guidance. Unless it complies with the standards set out in the SPG, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time, whether in use or not, without the prior written consent of the local planning authority. The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.london/.

Condition : 19 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, upon completion of the road surfacing and car parking spaces, lockable bollards shall be put in place on no less than four car parking spaces, with individual keys to access these parking spaces provided to the occupiers of 6, 7, 7A and 8 Upper Butts. This shall ensure that the use of the approved parking bays are solely used by authorised key holders and by no other persons. The approved parking layout and lockable bollards shall be retained as such thereafter.
